description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data across six distinct categories, labeled 0 through 5, with each slice representing a proportion of the total dataset. The largest segment, labeled 0, accounts for 27.2% (8006 instances) and is colored light blue. The second largest segment, labeled 2, represents 22.4% (6583 instances) and is depicted in light green. Segment 1, in light yellow, constitutes 13.8% (4046 instances), while segment 0, in a cream color, makes up 13.3% (3910 instances). Segment 3, shown in light olive green, accounts for 6.8% (2002 instances), and segment 4, in light blue, represents 6.2% (1810 instances). The smallest segment, labeled 5, is colored light blue and comprises 10.4% (3043 instances). The chart displays percentage values and corresponding numerical counts within each slice, with the categories arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top.
